description:
No spec subject — bookkeeping epic.

Impromptu epic created 2026-07-27 to land 21 independently-surfaced follow-up tickets on a SINGLE PR, extending the 0.10.0 release already opened on the specled_-td7 branch. Children were each carved by an earlier ticket cold verification, critical review, or the 0.9.6 fast-follow sweep, and had no owning epic.

## BASE AND ALREADY-LANDED WORK

This epic branches from feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors at e81f9f98, NOT from main. That branch is 10 commits ahead of main and 0 behind, and already carries two implemented + cold-verified tickets that ship on this same PR:
  - specled_-td7  gate forensics + self-identifying failing-test descriptors (IMPLEMENTED, VERIFY: PASS)
  - specled_-n5s  Store.write_v2/2 ArgumentError contract (IMPLEMENTED, VERIFY: PASS)
It also already bumped VERSION to 0.10.0 and opened the CHANGELOG entry. Do NOT re-bump; extend the existing 0.10.0 section.

## ADMISSION VERIFICATION (2026-07-27)

All 22 candidate tickets were cold-verified against the td7 tree by one fresh-context agent each before this epic was formed. Result: zero were already_done, zero obsolete. One premise_wrong (specled_-4pl) and three partially_done (specled_-26g, specled_-npo, specled_-4f7) had their mandates narrowed or rewritten during admission — see the per-ticket ADMISSION comments. specled_-4a6 was verified still_applicable but CUT from this epic by user decision; see its comment.

## SEQUENCING RATIONALE

Waves are derived from a file-collision map, not from caution. Every serialization below names the file the two tickets share; tickets with disjoint file sets run concurrently.

Wave 1 (11, fully parallel): wby, ako, yds, vbo, pii, ehv, dn4.12, npo, zek, z5t, chb, 4pl
Wave 2 (7, each behind exactly one Wave-1 ticket): 26g<-ehv, asb<-ehv, zd8<-dn4.12, b23<-dn4.12, ozm<-4pl+ehv, 14t<-zek, 4f7<-pii
Wave 3 (2): xkn.1<-26g+npo, xkn.2<-z5t+ozm

Orchestrated by /orchestrate-epic.
title: [EPIC] Impromptu: 0.10.0 fast-follow sweep — gate-forensics reach, spec.validate usage tier, doc-lint hardening, coverage-store safety, review polish
